name: 고차 통계
description: 분석합니다 kurtosis and skewness of 기울기 분포s. Natural images have heavy-tailed 분포s while AI images tend toward Gaussian.
algorithm: Gradient Domain Kurtosis and Skewness Analysis
mechanism: Computes first-order 기울기 differences and 분석 their higher-order 통계적 moments. AI images show more Gaussian-like 분포s.
useCase: Detecting Gaussian-like 기울기 statistics in AI 생성 images

references.title: Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2006). Steganalysis Using Higher-Order Image Statistics. IEEE TIFS.
Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Mendel, J.M. (1991). Tutorial on Higher-Order Statistics. Proceedings of the IEEE.

strengths:
• Captures non-Gaussian properties invisible to basic statistics
• Skewness and kurtosis reveal AI 분포 이상
• Fast computation on pixel 분포s
• Format-independent 분석
• Strong theoretical foundation in 통계적 signal processing
limitations:
• Lower standalone discrimination power
• Sensitive to image content type (sky vs complex scene)
• Post-processing can normalize 분포s
• Requires sufficient image size for stable statistics
• Some AI models produce natural-looking 분포s
